design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — alterations_and_tailoring task 1 (env_0061, Marlowe & Finch Alterations). Revision 3 (after the policy-task audit of round 2).
[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 -> prerequisite_problems=3, factor_counts=[5,4,5,6]. Assignment: alteration_ext_extra_fitting_fee (root) 6, alteration_ext_added_work_lining 4, alteration_ext_quote_overrun 5, alteration_ext_complimentary_work 5.
[Scope snapshot] Task 0 holds rush fee, rush fee waiver and deposit. Task 1 claims the added-work lining, quote overrun, complimentary work and extra fitting policies with tools book_lined_surcharge_bf0414f9, waive_quote_overrun_938dcea5, waive_complimentary_work_96f02105, book_extra_fitting_87db3b08 (owner=user). Every extended policy is claimed exactly once.
[Why a good test] The customer only wants to book one more fitting for his lined Standard Alterations trousers. The fitting-fee rule waits on the complimentary waiver owed on the qualifying hem and on the waiver of the charges running past the honored quote; the overrun rule waits on the lined surcharge of the operation added after drop-off that still has none. The agent must book the surcharge (4 factors), the overrun waiver (5), the complimentary waiver (5), then quote and hand over the fitting (6).
[World] Ticket AT-5418306 dropped off 2026-10-28 with hem_plain 18.00 + 3.60, side_seams_take_in 34.00 + 6.80 and taper_legs 38.00 + 7.60 (lined surcharges at the class 20 percent), quoted_total 108.00; waist_let_out 32.00 added at the 2026-11-10 fitting without approval and without a lined surcharge; extra fitting 1 charged 7.50 on 2026-11-10; balance 147.50, no payment. Purchase MF55962: sale 206.50 (regular 295.00), completed 2026-07-20, charged to the active World Elite Mastercard (card transaction seeded). Platinum member enrolled 2016-02-10. Wedding Registry event 2026-12-05.
[Problem-tree card] root alteration_ext_extra_fitting_fee (user write). Edges, all value_input and state form: fitting -> complimentary work ('The fee for an extra fitting is fixed only after the ticket carries the complimentary waiver owed on its qualifying operations.'; false at opening: hem_plain carries no complimentary_basic waiver although 17.00 is owed); fitting -> quote overrun ('An extra fitting fee is not booked until any operation charges running past the honored quote stand waived on the ticket.'; false: operation and lined charges 140.00 exceed the honored amount and no quote_overrun row exists); overrun -> lining ('The quote overrun waiver is worked out only after every operation added to a lined garment's ticket after its drop-off carries its lined surcharge, in a class that charges one.'; false: waist_let_out has no lined surcharge). Each state is brought about by exactly one tool. Order: lining, overrun, complimentary, fitting; the complimentary waiver commutes with the first two (calc: complimentary 17.00 and overrun 31.73 in either order; fitting fee 17.00 for both orders).
Deletion sensitivity (calc): skip the lined surcharge -> overrun 28.40 instead of 31.73, and with the overrun so recomputed the fitting fee becomes 15.00 (chargeable work 76.60); skip the complimentary waiver -> chargeable work 90.27, small-job surcharge 2.00, fee 15.00; skip the overrun waiver -> chargeable work 105.00, no surcharge, fee 13.00.
[Factor card — added-work lined surcharge 3.50] lined_work_basis_form (method): waist_let_out charged 32.00, under 40.00 -> flat lining charge 5.00 (standard 20 percent of 32.00 = 6.40 -> 4.48). member_lining_discount: own purchase named and Platinum -> 10 (baseline -> 4.00). recent_purchase_lining_discount: completed 2026-07-20, operation booked 2026-11-10, 113 days -> 10 (baseline -> 4.00). ticket_size_lining_discount: operation charges 122.00 -> 10 (baseline -> 4.00). 5.00 x 70% = 3.50; all baselines 6.40.
[Factor card — quote overrun 31.73] overrun charges after the surcharge 122.00 + 3.60 + 6.80 + 7.60 + 3.50 = 143.50; quoted_total 108.00. quote_tolerance_form (method): exactly one operation after drop-off and Platinum -> tolerance percentage of the 35.50 above the quote (standard: percentage of the quote -> 28.10). standing_quote_tolerance: Platinum and an active card -> 5 percent (baseline class 10 -> 29.95). extra_fitting_allowance: one extra fitting -> 5.00 (baseline -> 35.50, the honored amount then floored at the quote). own_purchase_quote_credit: own sale-price purchase -> 1.00 (baseline -> 30.73). membership_tenure_quote_credit: 129 months -> 2.00 (baseline -> 29.73). Honored 108.00 + 1.775 + 5.00 - 1.00 - 2.00 = 111.775 (not below the quote); waiver 143.50 - 111.775 = 31.725 -> 31.73; all baselines 24.70.
[Factor card — complimentary work 17.00] highest qualifying operation charge, no complimentary waiver yet: hem_plain 18.00 (side seams, taper and waist let-out are not qualifying). complimentary_waiver_form (method): sale price and Platinum -> lesser of the charge and the sale-work allowance (standard: sale -> nothing -> 0.00). member_sale_work_allowance: Platinum -> 14.00 (fall-through nothing, the standard treatment -> 0.00). premium_garment_addition: allowance above zero, regular_price 295.00 -> +3.00 (baseline -> 14.00). finch_circle_window_extension: Platinum -> +30 days (baseline: window 75 < 100 days -> 0.00). card_charged_window_extension: purchase charged to the active World Elite Mastercard -> +15 (baseline: 90 < 100 -> 0.00). Window 105; 2026-07-20 to 2026-10-28 = 100 days. Waiver min(18.00, 17.00) = 17.00; the hem's lined surcharge stays chargeable. All baselines 0.00.
[Factor card — extra fitting fee 17.00] fitting_number_basis (method): no needed_by_date -> 15.00 x fitting number 2 = 30.00 (standard flat 15.00 -> 9.50). member_fitting_rate: Platinum -> 50 percent (baseline -> 32.00). event_proximity_surcharge: Wedding Registry event 2026-12-05, 18 days -> +5.00 (baseline -> 12.00). small_job_fitting_surcharge: chargeable work = operation charges 122.00 less waivers 17.00 and 31.73 = 73.27, under 75.00 -> +4.00 (baseline -> 13.00). wedding_party_credit: -4.00 (baseline -> 21.00). cardmember_fitting_credit: World Elite -> -3.00 (baseline -> 20.00). 15.00 + 5 + 4 - 4 - 3 = 17.00; all baselines 15.00. Extra fitting 1 (2026-11-10) is seeded at 7.50, this policy's figure for fitting 1 on that date with the owed surcharge and waivers applied (chargeable 69.50 -> +4; event 25 days -> +3).
[Base-invariant card] Charges: alteration_pricing and alteration_rush_service, no gate on alteration_charge. Waivers: alteration_agg_complimentary_per_purchase, alteration_complimentary_basic (time gate retired by the declared window overwrite; drop-off 100 days after completion within 105), alteration_rush_service, alteration_cancellation_rules, alteration_remake_rules. temporal_feasibility is empty.
[Business-object card] Ticket AT-5418306 (one pair of trousers, purchase MF55962). The surcharge names waist_let_out; the overrun waiver is booked against the unapproved waist_let_out charge; the complimentary waiver names the hem_plain charge; the fitting is extra fitting 2.
[Persona] Marcus asks only to book one more fitting; identity, ticket and wedding date on request; agrees to fixes without naming them; records the fitting himself (the shop sets its time).
[Solution] find_customers(phone) -> verify(phone, DOB) -> ticket, charges, purchases, card accounts, card transactions, membership, benefit ledger, registries -> surcharge 3.50 on waist_let_out -> overrun waiver 31.73 against waist_let_out -> complimentary waiver 17.00 on hem_plain -> hand over extra fitting 2 at 17.00 (the customer's call records the fitting and its fee; the shop sets its time).
[Round 3 closure] R2-1: the overrun tolerance forms are now a flat 5.00 per added operation (two or more), the tolerance percentage of the excess over the quote (one added operation, Platinum or above), and the tolerance percentage of the quote (anyone else) — three different formulas; the dollar tolerance factor is replaced by a tolerance-percentage factor that every percentage form uses. R2-2: the lining forms are now a flat 5.00 (under 40.00), 2.00 per lined operation the lining is reworked around (40.00 or more with two or more surcharges standing), and the class percentage of the charge — three different formulas. O-R2-1: the policy now books one complimentary waiver per ticket and declares the retirement of the cross-ticket count for its waiver; the lined surcharge of a waived operation stays chargeable in every case, so no unowned row is promised. O-R2-2: the honored amount is never below the quoted_total and the fall-through form covers every remaining ticket, so the waiver never reaches approved work. O-R2-3: the sale-work allowance falls through to nothing (the standard treatment) and the premium addition applies only to a positive allowance. O-R2-4/T1-3: the fitting fee's chargeable work now counts operation charges only, so the lining write reaches the fee through the recomputed overrun. The world now has one operation added after drop-off (taper at drop-off).
[Round 4 closure] R3-1: the fitting fee basis forms are now the fee times the fitting number (no needed-by date: open-ended fitting rounds), the fee plus ten percent of the ticket's operation charges (needed-by date today or within the next fourteen days: a late fitting re-checks the whole job), and the flat fee (needed-by date further out or already passed). Every pair of tiers differs on a concrete input of the other tier's domain (worklog table). This customer has no needed-by date, so the figure is unchanged. O-R3-2: the complimentary override now states that any further qualifying operation on the ticket stays chargeable, so no case is left to a rule without a tool. Reads: the wedding proximity surcharge and the wedding-party credit read the active Wedding Registry (one registry per type), with Anniversary or Celebration registries as the second party-credit tier; card tiers test active Elite or World Elite accounts, or any active account; the card window extension tests whether the purchase's card account is an active account of the customer; the lining charge takes the higher operation when several share the latest booking date, and owes nothing on a ticket without operations. Decoy and absent-record probes leave every figure unchanged or take the fall-through tier without error.
[Round 5 closure — renderer source items] No scored value moved. Complimentary: the premium-garment addition is read from the regular price alone; the method factor decides only the form (whole charge / allowance / no waiver) from the price type and its own membership read, and the result assembles the waiver (the lesser of the charge and the allowance plus the premium, nothing without an allowance). The lined-surcharge overwrite now names its scope. Quote overrun: the method factor decides only the tolerance form (per-operation / excess / quote) from the added-operation count and its own membership read; the result assembles the tolerance with the tolerance percentage. Fitting fee: the wedding-party credit reads the Wedding Registry event date itself instead of the proximity factor's bindings. The extra-fitting tool docstring now says exactly what the call does: it records the extra fitting fee with the fitting's number and does not set a time; the persona accepts the shop setting the time. Lining: the result is guarded to an operation added after drop-off while an operation still lacks a surcharge; the rush fee likewise to rush tickets. A mechanical listing shows that no factor of any policy reads a binding owned by another factor.
user_scenario: You are Marcus Whitfield, 36, a high-school chemistry teacher in Dallas, easygoing and chatty, getting married on December 5. You bought a pair of charcoal Ashby dress trousers from mfinch.com over the summer and have had them in with the Marlowe & Finch alterations shop since the end of October for a hem and some fitting work. You have already been in for two fittings, and the tailor told you at the last one that he would like to see you once more before he finishes. You are calling because you want to book one more fitting with the tailor for the trousers, and you understand there is a fee for an extra fitting; you are happy to book it yourself if they set it up for you. You start with something like: "Hey there — I've got some trousers in with your alterations shop for my wedding, and I want to book one more fitting with the tailor before they finish them." You do not know what the extra fitting costs and you say so if asked; you have no figure in mind. When the agent asks to confirm who you are, you give your mobile number, 2145550164, and your date of birth, 1990-07-22; if they want one more detail you give your ZIP code, 75206. If they ask which garment or ticket, you read your claim stub: ticket AT-5418306, the charcoal dress trousers. If they ask when you need them, you say the wedding is December 5 — you never gave the shop a needed-by date and you don't think one is on the ticket. If the agent explains that some things on the ticket have to be put right or worked out before the fitting fee can be set, you say that is fine with you and to go ahead; you do not ask what they are and you don't argue. When the agent tells you the fitting fee and hands the booking over to you, you complete it yourself exactly as described, with the fitting number and fee they give you, and read back the confirmation if asked. You are not paying anything today; the balance is settled when you pick the trousers up, and you say so if the agent asks about paying. If the agent says the shop will call you to settle the day and time of the fitting, that is fine with you. Once the agent confirms the extra fitting is on the ticket you thank the agent, joke that this is the last thing on your wedding list, and end the call.
